problem.title: Count Elements Equal to X in a Range
problem.problemStatement: Given an array of integers and multiple queries, determine how many elements equal X occur in each specified range.
problem.input: • First line contains N. • Second line contains N integers. • Third line contains Q. • Each of the next Q lines contains L, R, and X.
problem.output: • For each query print the required count.
